captions.detailed: This 3D-printable model is a robust, front-mountable bicycle water bottle holder. It features a thick, cylindrical main body with a grid of large circular cutouts to save weight and material. On one side, it integrates a solid, blocky vertical mounting bracket with pre-formed bolt holes and nut recesses for secure attachment to a bicycle frame or handlebar tube. The bottom of the cage has a semi-open base with a central circular drainage hole to support the bottle while allowing water to escape.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric front-mountable bicycle water bottle cage. It must feature adjustable parameters for the bottle diameter, cage height, wall thickness, and mounting tube diameters, with a grid of weight-reducing circular cutouts around the main sleeve and a integrated mounting bracket with standard bolt and nut recesses.
captions.factory: The code constructs the cage using a boolean difference operation on a combined base holder. The base holder consists of a vertical mounting block (cube) and the main bottle sleeve (linear_extrude of nested circles). The difference operation then subtracts a bottom drainage sphere, horizontal handlebar mounting cylinders, various 3mm and 6mm bolt and nut holes (using custom modules with circle/cylinder primitives), and a nested loop of rotated cylinders that pierce the sleeve to create the pattern of circular weight-reduction holes.
